title: 8 Questions a Godly Man Asks Himself Before He Asks Her Out
caption:
Before you ask her out, ask yourself a few things first. None of them are about her.

Are you chasing God harder than you're chasing her? Would your brothers say you're ready? Are you lonely, or actually ready? Is there a life you're inviting her into, or are you hoping she'll start one for you?

The guy walking with God becomes the guy worth saying yes to. The order matters.

"Seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you." Matthew 6:33

Save this for before you send the text. Send it to the brother who's been talking about her all week.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #dating #singleness
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
